remaining_gaps: Missing packet evidence: the National Emergencies Act continuation notices for the Libya emergency (Notices of February 22, 2022, February 17, 2023, February 21, 2024, February 20, 2025 and February 13, 2026; 87 FR 10681, 88 FR 10823, 89 FR 13969, 90 FR 10573, 91 FR 7801) are held as jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-2022-04104.txt, fr-2023-03747.txt, fr-2024-03940.txt, fr-2025-03104.txt and fr-2026-03279.txt and are declared in HELD_SUPPLEMENT.json (aliases HELD13726_2 through HELD13726_6), but the dossier lists each as an acting text whose number was not found and registers no citable evidence id for any of them, so a claim cannot cite them as later events. The only other current-law records are a U.S. Code zip held as a hash only (custody_record_only, xml_uscAll@119-121.zip) and eCFR sections of 31 CFR part 570. A source supplement registering the Libya continuation notices is needed before a YES claim can be assembled.
